# Orchard grafting notes

Grafting joins a cutting, the scion, to a rooted plant, the rootstock.

## When to graft

Cut the scions in January while the buds are dormant and store them wrapped
in damp paper in a cold cellar. Graft in April, when the rootstock sap starts
to rise.

## Whip and tongue

Make a long sloping cut on both scion and rootstock. Cut a small tongue into
each face so that the two halves lock together. Bind the join with grafting
tape and seal the tip of the scion with wax.

## Aftercare

Remove any shoots that grow from below the join. They come from the rootstock
and would take over the tree.
